content.title: Dallas Cowboys’ 2026 NFL schedule ‘leaked’ online with huge Week 3 matchup and home and away games revealed
content.text: THE Dallas Cowboys’ 2026 NFL schedule has seemingly been shared online. A huge Week 3 matchup is set to be scheduled with the Cowboys‘ home and away games revealed. Sign up for the Sport newsletter Thank you! Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott stands on the sideline against the Denver BroncosCredit: Getty Cowboys star Prescott looks to pass against the Minnesota VikingsCredit: Getty This leaked schedule shows that the Cowboys are due to play nine home games and eight away games during the 2026 NFL season. But this includes the franchise being the designated home team for the league’s International Series game in Brazil. The Cowboys are due to play at the world-famous Maracana Stadium in Rio de Janeiro during Week 3. This follows two years of the league featuring at Neo Quimica Arena in Sao Paulo. They are set to face off against the Baltimore Ravens, according to The Baltimore Banner. Previous games in Brazil have been held on Friday nights. The Cowboys are set to face divisional rivals the New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles, and Washington Commanders home and away. They are also set to face the NFC West’s Arizona Cardinals and San Francisco 49ers at home with visits to the Los Angeles Rams and Seattle Seahawks. Most read in Sport Elsewhere in the NFC, the Cowboys will host the Tampa Bay Buccaneers while traveling to the Green Bay Packers. The Cowboys’ home interconference games will be held against the Jacksonville Jaguars and the Tennessee Titans. While they will hit the road to visit the Houston Texans and the Indianapolis Colts. It will be a crucial season for the franchise as owner Jerry Jones, 83, hopes to reach the team’s first Super Bowl in 30 years. The Cowboys failed to reach the playoffs in 2025 after picking up just seven wins and one tie. But Jones continues to back head coach Brian Schottenheimer, 52, after leading one of the league’s strongest offenses. Dallas Cowboys 2026 schedule Home Opponents Arizona Cardinals San Francisco 49ers Jacksonville Jaguars Tennessee Titans Baltimore Ravens Tampa Bay Buccaneers New York Giants Philadelphia Eagles Washington Commanders Away Opponents Houston Texans Indianapolis Colts Los Angeles Rams Seattle Seahawks Green Bay Packers New York Giants Philadelphia Eagles Washington Commanders Jones has placed the blame on defensive coordinator Matt Eberflus, 55, with Christian Parker, 34, taking over in the role. The league is expected to announce the Cowboys’ official 2026 schedule in May after the NFL Draft. Comments
